outcome: Childbirth experience (measured by the Wijma Delivery Experience Questionnaire)
cohort: Two hundred and twenty-one Italian women who had recently given birth.
finding: While women's perceived childbirth experience remained consistent over time, the predictors of this experience differed between immediately after birth and 3 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Immediately after birth, only the type of Cesarean section significantly predicted childbirth experience.
